description:
Writing marvellous stories for young kids about the Mars rovers Opportunity (Oppy) and Spirit. We hope our story inspires youngsters to love space adventures and one day join us here.

Team: Yizen (12) - NASA app fan, dreams of joining NASA. Deshawn (11) - loves rover models, dreams of visiting NASA. Kayra (11) - space fact reader since age 3, future astronomer.
summary: Twins on the Red Planet is a short illustrated story for children about Spirit and Opportunity, NASA’s twin Mars rovers. Created for the challenge “Abandoned but Not Forgotten”, it tells how each rover explored a different part of Mars, what they discovered, and why they are remembered even though they now rest silently on the planet. We used simple words and many pictures so young kids can follow the adventure. The story shows how robots help us explore places humans cannot yet reach, and how much we can learn about our universe from them.
details:
Twins on the Red Planet is a children’s story about Spirit and Opportunity, the twin NASA rovers that landed on Mars in 2004. We made it for the challenge “Abandoned but Not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA’s Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars.” Using mostly pictures and simple words, the story helps young kids understand what rovers are, what they found on Mars, and why they are still remembered after their missions ended. It is an inspirational story about how robots and technology can explore the universe and help us understand it.

We designed the story in Canva, using bright, creative fonts to attract children’s attention. Our information came from NASA’s website and app, plus Google and YouTube research. Our young team challenged ourselves to turn “abandoned but not forgotten” into a story children can feel.
